names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 15 noiembrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Paisie de la Neamț».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 15 Νοεμβρίου, «Όσιος Παΐσιος Βελιτσκόφσκυ», with the rank words left off. The surname the page prints in Greek letters, «Βελιτσκόφσκυ», is left out of the bare personal form.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his line for 15 ноября ст. ст., «Паисий Величковский, прп.», with the rank word left off. The surname is part of the name and stays; the line itself gives both in the genitive.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «s-a născut în orașul Poltava din Ucraina în anul 1722, la 21 decembrie, într-o binecuvântată familie preoțească, fiind al unsprezecelea copil din cei doisprezece frați».

death.note: doxologia.ro: in 1794, «îmbolnăvindu-se, și-a dat sufletul său curat în mâinile Domnului nostru Iisus Hristos în seara zilei de joi, 15 noiembrie, la vârsta de 72 de ani», and was buried on Saturday 17 November.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 ноября ст. ст. — «Прп. Паисия Величковского (1794).»

feast.note: His life says his disciples appointed 15 noiembrie as his yearly commemoration, and that the Holy Synod of the Romanian Orthodox Church ordered his commemoration as a saint in 1992, entering him in the calendar on that day.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 15 noiembrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Paisie de la Neamț»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Παΐσιος Βελιτσκόφσκυ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The head line gives him «(1722 - 1794)», the same interval the folder already carries, so **no `dates` are proposed**. The entry is plainly him, and the page is a bare chronology, which it says so itself — «Επιγραμματικά και με χρονολογική σειρά αναφέρουμε τα σημαντικότερα γεγονότα της ζωής του Ρώσου Αγίου»: born 21 December 1722, entered the theological school of Kyiv in 1734, the monasteries of Lyubech and Medvedovsky near Kyiv in 1738, a rasophore monk renamed **Plato** in 1741, the skete of Wallachia with the elder Basil two years later, the Holy Mountain in 1746, tonsured by the elder Basil and renamed **Paisius** in 1750, coenobitic life with Bessarion in 1754, ordained priest and founder of the skete of the Prophet Elijah in 1758, Dragomirna in 1763, Secu in 1775, Neamț in 1779, archimandrite in 1790, dead on 15 November 1794; his incorrupt relic lies in the katholikon of the monastery of Neamț in Romania. The page calls him a **Russian** saint. No `locations` and no hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

hymns.text: Apărătorule al dreptei credințe și lauda monahilor, Cuvioase Părinte Paisie, din pruncie iubind pe Hristos, ca un alt Avraam ai părăsit patria ta, în Muntele Athosului nevoindu-te; și, adunând ceată de ucenici, te-ai așezat în țara Moldovei cea binecuvântată și Mănăstirea Neamțului rai pământesc ai făcut-o. Pentru aceasta, împreună cu îngerii, nu înceta a te ruga lui Dumnezeu pentru sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — «Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Paisie de la Neamț», glas 4, his own proper

english.text: Defender of the right faith and praise of monks, venerable father Paisius, loving Christ from thy infancy thou didst leave thy homeland like another Abraham, labouring on the Mountain of Athos; and gathering a company of disciples thou didst settle in the blessed land of Moldavia and didst make the monastery of Neamț an earthly paradise. Therefore, together with the angels, cease not to pray to God for our souls.

hymns.text: Странен быв на земли,/ Небеснаго Отечества достигл еси/ преподобне отче Паисие,/ добротолюбия подвижниче,/ верных научил ум к Богу возводити/ и сердцем к Нему взывати:/ Господи Иисусе Христе, Сыне Божий,/ помилуй мя, грешнаго.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 ноября ст. ст. — «Тропарь преподобного Паисия Величковского», глас 2. His own, and it names him.

english.text: A stranger on the earth, you reached the heavenly Fatherland, venerable father Paisius, ascetic of the love of the good; you taught the faithful to lead the mind up to God and to call on Him from the heart: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner.

hymns.text: Избранный иноческаго жития ревнителю, яко пчела многотрудная писаньми отеческими души наша снабдил еси, коегождо наставляя на путь спасения, сего ради зовем ти: радуйся, Паисие премудре, старчества духовнаго в стране нашей возродителю.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 ноября ст. ст. — «Кондак преподобного Паисия Величковского», глас 8. His own, and it names him.

english.text: Chosen zealot of the monastic life, like a bee of much labour you furnished our souls with the writings of the fathers, guiding each one onto the path of salvation; and for this we cry to you: rejoice, most wise Paisius, who raised up spiritual eldership again in our land.
